buildReceipts.anti_circularity_note: Training corpora are built ONLY from fixtures/noisy-estate/ documents. The 60 eval questions and expectedValues live in fixtures/noisy-estate-manifest.json and are read scorer-side by run-track-k-composition-head-to-head.py only; nothing GT-shaped enters any corpus.
buildReceipts.zero_egress_note: The builder performs no network I/O: perception, corpus seam, pair compiler, graph index and PPR retrieval are all local file + wasm computation.

flat.note: positional 800-char windows over the estate in document order

composed.note: readable composed corpus (join is the training unit)

composed_pairs.note: composed corpus + identity-contrastive pairs merged into ONE file in deterministic hash-id order (pair ids are sha256), so equal-budget truncation never removes a whole part

canaries.embedding: identical chat rows appended after the estate rows in EVERY training-arm corpus at build time; the runner keeps them outside the capped estate budget so per-arm canary exposure is measured on an identical canary input at parity

pprContexts.retrievalPath: track-C Graph-PPR (PortableDocumentGraph.pprRetrieve topK 6), contexts mapped back to raw estate text by passage lineIndex for parity with the readable training arms

flatChunker.order: manifest document order, then byte position

notes: composed_pairs is the composed corpus plus the identity-contrastive pairs JSONL merged into one training file in deterministic hash-id order.
The equal token budget is computed training-side (Qwen tokenizer, assistant-target tokens); the per-char token estimates here are provenance only.
Vaulted composed is not implemented (loud TypeError by design) so the readable-vs-vaulted ablation rides the per-block arm; recorded as the deviation it is.
The fluent readable per-block seam is also the pair compiler input, so arm composed_pairs carries pairs compiled from the same per-block state (no rebuilding).

anti_circularity_note: Training corpora are built ONLY from fixtures/noisy-estate/ documents. The 60 eval questions and expectedValues live in fixtures/noisy-estate-manifest.json and are read scorer-side by run-track-k-composition-head-to-head.py only; nothing GT-shaped enters any corpus.
zero_egress_note: zero egress except the localhost Ollama judge calls (127.0.0.1:11434); eval payloads carry question/reference/answer only; canaries never enter any judge payload
evalQuestions: manifest-authored (60; Q1 24 / Q2 24 / Q3 12); training corpora see only estate documents; GT lives in the manifest and this scorer only

deepseek.deviation: OpenRouter key absent (env OPENROUTER_API_KEY or MLE/.orkey); local judges only per the handoff abort rule. DeepSeek votes backfill on re-run once a key exists.
